blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Merging multiple adapters into a single image generation model reduces deployment costs while preserving diverse task capabilities or personalization modes. State-of-the-art methods such as RegMean, Mix-of-Show, and Subspace Routing fit the outputs of the merged model to those of the individual adapters using ordinary least squares (OLS). We show that this reconstruction objective systematically shrinks task-specific signals whenever the activation distributions of different tasks overlap, producing a merged adapter that is too weak for downstream use. We derive a decomposition that quantifies this shrinkage and propose rescaling the merged update to restore signal strength. On multi-subject personalization with up to 30 merged adapters, rescaling substantially improves subject fidelity over unscaled baselines. Our approach also improves results on style transfer, concept erasure, image classification, and LLM-based text classification.
blocks.zh: 将多个适配器合并成一个单一的图像生成模型,既能降低部署成本,又能保留多种任务能力或个性化模式. 先进的方法,如RegMean,Mix-of-Show,和Subspace Routing,将合并模型的输出与使用普通最小平方(OLS)的单个适配器的输出相匹配. 我们显示,每当不同任务的激活分布重叠时,这一重建目标系统收缩了任务特定信号,产生了一个无法下游使用的合并适配器. 我们得到一个分解 以量化这种收缩 并提出调整合并更新 以恢复信号强度 在多主体个性化方面,最多可有30个合并的适配器,比起未分级的基线,调整对主体的忠诚程度大有改进。 我们的方法还改进了样式转移、概念去除、图像分类和基于LLM的文本分类的结果。

blocks.en:
Low-rank adapters (LoRAs) [ 27 ] have become the standard way to personalize text-to-image diffusion models. A few images are enough to teach a model a new subject [ 50 ] , an artistic style, or an erasure that removes a concept from the model [ 39 , 19 ] .
Many applications need several of these adapters in one model, for example to generate any of a set of personalized subjects or styles, or to erase a list of unwanted concepts at once.
blocks.zh:
低档适配器(Loras)[27]已经成为将文本到图像传播模型个性化的标准方式. 少数图像足以教给一个模型一个新的科目[50],一种艺术风格,或一种消除一个概念的模型[39,19].
许多应用程序在一个模型中需要几个这样的适配器,例如生成任意一组个性化主题或风格,或者同时删除一个不想要的概念列表.

blocks.en:
One option is to train a single adapter on the images of all subjects together. This requires the training images of every subject, which are often unavailable because adapters are typically shared as weights without their data, and the training has to be repeated whenever a subject is added.
The alternative is to combine independently trained adapters into one set of weights without further training, which is the model merging problem [ 30 , 73 , 79 , 40 , 59 , 22 , 52 ] .
blocks.zh:
一个选择是对所有主体的图像一起培训一个单一的适配器. 这就需要每个科目的培训图像,这些图像往往不可用,因为适配器通常在没有数据的情况下作为权重共享,每次增加一个科目时都必须重复培训。
另一种办法是将经过独立培训的适配器合并为一组重量而不经过进一步培训,这就是模型合并问题[30、73、79、40、59、22、52]。

blocks.en:
Merging becomes difficult when many adapters are combined. All adapters modify the same layers, and their prompts share most of their text embedding, so each adapter also changes the images generated for the other adapters’ prompts. This interference grows with the number of adapters.
Weight-space methods ignore the input distribution adapters were trained on, and their subject fidelity drops substantially as more adapters are merged ( Tab. 1 ).
Data-based methods instead fit the merged weights so that each merged layer reproduces the output of every adapter on that adapter’s own inputs, which can be formalized as an ordinary least squares (OLS) problem [ 32 , 22 , 8 , 67 ] .
Among them, Subspace Routing (SSR) [ 67 ] is particularly well suited for many adapters. It solves the OLS problem in the low-rank bottleneck of the LoRAs, so its closed-form solution scales with the total adapter rank instead of the layer width. SSR routes each prompt to the correct adapter, yet the subjects still fade as more adapters are merged ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
当许多适配器被合并时,合并变得很困难. 所有适配器都修改了相同的层,他们的提示分享了大部分的文本嵌入,因此每个适配器也改变为其他适配器的提示生成的图像. 这种干扰随着适配器数量的增长而增加.
重量-空间方法忽略了输入分配适配器的培训,随着更多的适配器被合并,其主题的忠诚度大幅下降(Tab.1 )。
基于数据的方法相反符合合并的权重,使每个合并的层复制每个适配器在适配器自身投入上的输出,这可以被正式化为普通的最小方(OLS)问题[32,22,8,67].
其中,Subspace Routing(SSR)[67]特别适合许多适配器. 它解决了LORAs低档瓶颈中的OLS问题,因此它的闭式溶液尺度为总适配器排名而不是层宽. SSR路由每条快速到正确的适配器,然而随着更多适配器的合并(图1),主体仍然消退.

blocks.en: We trace this to a systematic weakness of OLS-based merging, which we call shrinkage. When the inputs of the adapters overlap, no merged layer can reproduce the output of every adapter exactly, and the least-squares solution returns a scaled-down version γ ​ Y \gamma Y , with γ < 1 \gamma<1 , of each adapter’s output Y Y plus interference from the other adapters ( Fig. 2 ). This is related to regression dilution in statistics [ 18 ] . OLS treats a weakened signal and added interference as equally bad, but the generated images are more sensitive to the weakened signal: with 30 LoRAs, reducing the interference 20-100 × \times doesn’t help much, while undoing the shrinkage restores the subjects ( Fig. 2 (c)). Scaling the merged adapter up by a single factor therefore improves the merged model substantially.
blocks.zh: 我们追踪到基于LS的合并的系统性弱点,我们称之为收缩。 当适配器的输入重叠时,任何合并层都不能完全复制每个适配器的输出,最小方的溶液返回一个缩放版本 γ Y\gamma Y,其中每个适配器的输出 Y Y 加上来自其他适配器的干扰 < 1\gamma < 1 (图2). 这与统计中的回归稀释有关 [18]. OLS将一个弱化的信号和添加的干扰视为同样糟糕,但生成的图像对弱化的信号更为敏感:有30个LORA,减少干扰20-100×x\time没有多大帮助,同时解除收缩可以恢复对象(图2(c)). 因此,将合并的适配器用一个因素放大,大大改进了合并的模型。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: (1) We show that OLS-based merging methods like SSR, RegMean, and Mix-of-Show shrink the output of adapters, and that the merged model is more sensitive to this weakened output than to interference from other adapters. (2) From this analysis, we derive a rescaling factor 1 / γ 1/\gamma that is computed in closed form from the calibration data at almost no extra cost. Alternatively, the factor can be selected by a line search on validation data. (3) By correcting shrinkage, Scaled SSR outperforms state-of-the-art merging methods when merging 30 DreamBooth subjects, 20 artistic styles, and concept erasers. Rescaling also improves RegMean and Mix-of-Show, and transfers to image and text classification.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献是: (1)我们显示基于OSS的合并方法,如SSR,RegMean,和Mix-of-Show收缩了适配器的输出,合并的模型对这个弱化的输出比对其他适配器的干扰更敏感. (2) 从这项分析中,我们得出一个缩放系数1/γ1/\gamma,它是以封闭形式从校准数据中计算出来的,几乎不增加费用。 或者,可以通过在验证数据上进行行搜索来选择系数. (3)通过纠正收缩,缩放SSR在合并30个DreamBooth学科,20个艺术风格,以及概念擦除器时,超乎最先进的合并方法. 缩放还改进了RegMean和Mix-of-Show,并转至图像和文本分类.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Model Merging. This paper is about improving techniques to merge multiple LoRA adapters into a single adapter. Model merging [ 31 , 17 , 69 , 30 ] in general is a broad topic, so we refer to surveys like [ 36 , 74 , 24 , 25 ] for an overview. Classical merging methods operate on task vectors, i.e., the weight delta between base and fine-tuned model variants [ 30 ] , and modify the task vectors before merging [ 73 , 79 , 16 , 63 , 15 , 29 ] . Other methods decompose weight updates into complementary directions [ 40 , 83 , 21 , 9 , 6 , 70 , 23 , 60 , 47 , 65 , 53 , 56 ] . Some methods also use data to find relevant task subspaces, reduce noise, or mitigate task interference have been proposed [ 41 , 55 , 32 , 3 , 35 , 10 , 84 , 67 , 58 , 72 , 8 ] . For example, Jin et al. (RegMean) and Wei et al. (SSR) propose approaches for merging weights to minimize the prediction difference between the merged model and the individual models. Data can also be used for direct training or gradient-free optimization of merged weights [ 76 , 75 , 28 , 1 , 5 ] . Finally, LoRA adapters allow specifically tailored methods that operate on the individual projections and align shared directions of adapters [ 59 , 45 , 82 , 85 , 51 , 2 , 62 , 38 , 34 , 67 , 5 , 84 , 78 , 37 ] .
blocks.zh: 模型合并。 本文涉及改进将多个LORA适配器合并为一个适配器的技术. 模型合并[31,17,69,30]一般是一个广泛的话题,所以我们参考[36,74,24,25]这样的调查来进行概述. 古典合并方法在任务矢量上运行,即基数和微调模型变数之间的比重三角形[30],在合并前修改任务矢量[73,79,16,63,15,29]. 其他方法将权重更新分解为互补方向[40,83,21,9,6,70,23,60,47,65,53,56]. 一些方法还提出了使用数据寻找相关任务子空间,减少噪音,或减轻任务干扰[41,55,32,3,35,10,84,67,58,72,8]. 例如,龚等人. (RegMean)和魏等编. (SSR)提出合并权重的方法,以尽量减少合并模型和单个模型之间的预测差. 数据还可用于直接培训或对合并重量进行无梯度优化[76,75,28,1,5]. 最后,LORA适配器允许根据单个预测量身定制的方法,并统一适配器的共同方向[59,45,82,85,51,2,62,38,34,67,5,84,78,37].

blocks.en: Subject-Driven Image Generation. Our main application is few-shot subject-driven image generation [ 50 ] . Here, we adapt a text-to-image diffusion model [ 26 , 43 , 49 ] to generate images with a specific subject in different contexts, using only a few images of the subject. Since this task is very relevant and popular, developing specific merging methods for this task is an active field of research [ 52 , 7 , 67 , 22 , 54 , 46 , 44 , 77 , 42 , 71 , 86 ] .
blocks.zh: 主题驱动图像生成. 我们的主要应用是少拍主题驱动的图像生成[50]. 在这里,我们改编了一个文本到图像传播模型[26,43,49],以生成具有不同背景的特定主题的图像,只使用该主题的少数图像. 由于这项任务非常相关和受欢迎,为这项任务制定具体的合并方法是一个积极的研究领域[52、7、67、22、54、46、44、77、42、71、86]。

blocks.en: Shrinkage and LoRA Scaling. Our core insight is that merging methods that use ordinary least squares (OLS) systematically shrink the task signal, which is critical for the model. Shrinkage in OLS is a known phenomenon [ 13 , 14 , 68 , 18 ] , and our contribution is to analyze it for merging methods, show its relevance, and present a remedy through rescaling. PICO [ 62 ] and LiNeS [ 64 ] propose different rescaling methods with very different motivations. In Sec. B.1 we show that our method performs better.
blocks.zh: 缩水和LORA缩水。 我们的核心见解是,采用普通最小方块(OLS)的合并方法系统缩小任务信号,这对模型至关重要. OLS中的收缩是一个已知的现象[13,14,68,18],我们的贡献是分析它用于合并方法,显示其相关性,并通过缩放提出补救. PICO [62] 和LiNES [64] 提出不同的缩放方法,动机非常不同. 在B.1中,我们显示我们的方法表现得更好。

blocks.en: Task. We follow [ 67 ] and evaluate DreamBooth [ 50 ] as the main task. DreamBooth personalizes a text-to-image model like Flux1-dev or Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium to a specific subject from a few reference images. The model is fine-tuned to bind a rare identifier token to the subject, so that a prompt such as “a sks dog on the beach” renders that particular dog in a new context. We train one LoRA [ 27 ] per subject and merge K K of them into a single adapter. The merged model should preserve every subject it contains. For each subject, we therefore test whether it can still be generated faithfully when its identifier is used.
blocks.zh: 任务 我们遵循[67],并评价DreamBooth[50]为主要任务。 DreamBooth将Flux1-dev或Stable Difusion 3.5-Medium等文本对图像模型的个性化为从几个参考图像中的特定主题. 该模型经过微调,将稀有的识别符号绑在主体身上,这样,“沙滩上的一只滑轮狗”这样的提示就使得该特定狗处于新的环境之中。 我们每个课题训练一个LORA[27],并将其中的KK合并为一个适配器. 合并的模型应该保留它包含的每一个主题. 因此,对于每个问题,我们检验在使用其标识时,是否能够忠实地生成。

blocks.en: Subjects. In contrast to prior work, which evaluates subsets, we use all 30 subjects of the DreamBooth dataset [ 50 ] , i.e., we merge up to K = 30 K=30 adapters. These include 21 objects (e.g., backpacks, plushies, sneakers, toys) and 9 live subjects (2 cats and 7 dogs). Each subject has 4 to 6 reference images. For each pool size K ∈ { 3 , 5 , 9 , 15 , 20 , 30 } K\in\{3,5,9,15,20,30\} and each of the 30 subjects, we merge the adapter of the target subject and K − 1 K{-}1 other subjects drawn uniformly at random. blocks.en: 4.1 Comparison to SOTA Methods on Dreambooth

blocks.en: In Table 1 , we show subject fidelity for merging 9 to 30 DreamBooth LoRAs on FLUX.1-dev and SD3.5-M, measured by DINOv2 (D) and CLIP image (C) similarity to the reference images. First, we observe that weight-space methods fall behind activation-based methods at every scale, and the gap widens as more adapters are merged. On FLUX, the best weight-space result at 9 adapters (Core Space, .603 D) is already behind RegMean by .090, and at 30 adapters the best weight-space score (Iso-C, .502) is .185 below SSR with line search. Task Arithmetic loses .079 D between 9 and 30 adapters, whereas our method loses .024. Second, rescaling turns SSR from a mid-ranking baseline into the strongest method. Plain SSR is behind RegMean and Mix-of-Show at small K K , but adding 1 / γ 1/\gamma or line-search rescaling raises D at 30 adapters from .607 to .687 on FLUX and from .569 to .635 on SD3.5, with corresponding gains in C (.788 to .819 and .757 to .773). On SD3.5, SSR + Line Search obtains the best D score at every K K . On FLUX, it is best at 9 and 30 adapters and within .010 of the best method elsewhere. Third, RegMean is competitive at small K K (.693 vs .697 D at 9 adapters on FLUX) and IterIS at 15 and 20 adapters (.695 vs .691 and .683 vs .673). IterIS follows a stronger paradigm, since it accounts for the other adapters during merging, but in a data-matched setting it is much more expensive (94min / 426 PFLOPS for IterIS vs. 7min / 21 PFLOPS for SSR + 1 / γ 1/\gamma when merging 30 adapters on SD3.5-M, see Sec. B.3 ), and at K = 30 K=30 it falls behind our method by .026 D and .015 C.

blocks.en: WikiArt Style Transfer. We build an art style transfer task using 20 artists from the WikiArt dataset [ 61 ] . For each artist, we sample 25 training and 20 reference images (see Sec. C.3 ). Fig. 3 illustrates the quantitative trends. On DreamBooth (a), the gap between methods widens as the number of merged adapters grows. Task Arithmetic (TA) loses the subject early and at K = 30 K=30 produces a generic toy car or monster with no trace of the reference. RegMean and plain SSR retain some attributes, such as the red color of the car, but the subject gradually changes shape and identity as K K increases. Rescaling SSR by 1 / γ 1/\gamma or by α \alpha found by line search keeps both subjects close to the single-adapter reference across all K K , including the full pool of 30 adapters. This matches our analysis: the merged output is a shrunken copy of the target, and undoing the shrinkage recovers the subject even when many adapters overlap.
On WikiArt (b), TA, RegMean, and plain SSR drift towards a shared, generic painterly style, whereas the rescaled variants reproduce the distinct styles of Kuniyoshi, Beardsley, Escher, and Doré. On CIFAR-10 (c), RegMean and SSR still generate the erased classes, and TA also damages the kept class. Scaled SSR removes all erased classes while preserving the car.

blocks.en: 4.4 Performance on LLM and Classification Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.4 LLM和分类任务的业绩

blocks.en: Setting. We test whether rescaling merged adapters also improves performance on tasks other than image generation. Specifically, we test image classification, text classification, and text generation. Image Classification includes 20 image-classification tasks from [ 59 ] . Here, we train a LoRA adapter for each task on the CLIP ViT-B/32 and ViT-L/14 [ 48 ] image encoders and measure performance by accuracy. LLM-NLI and LLM-gen include 6 natural language inference tasks from [ 59 ] (LLM-NLI) and 3 generative tasks (math → \to GSM8K [ 12 ] , code → \to MBPP [ 4 ] , instruction following → \to IFEval [ 87 ] ). We train LoRAs for Llama-3.1-8B [ 20 ] on the provided NLI data for LLM-NLI and on the following datasets for LLM-gen: math → \to MetaMath [ 81 ] , code → \to Magicoder [ 66 ] , and instruction following → \to Tülu 3 SFT IF data [ 33 ] . LLM-NLI is evaluated by accuracy, and LLM-gen by the respective task metrics (exact match, pass@1, and the official scorer from lm-eval-harness for IFEval). LoRAHub includes 20 adapters selected from [ 28 ] . The adapters are trained for FLAN-T5 [ 11 ] one of 11 English NLP datasets, which cover question answering and binary judgement tasks like sentiment. Performance is measured by exact match accuracy.

blocks.en: Results. We show results in Fig. 4 . For each task and configuration, we report the percentage of the gap from plain SSR ( α = 1 \alpha=1 ) to the fine-tuned upper bound that is closed by the merged model. Here, a score of 50 means that half of the gap is closed. Across domains, rescaling consistently yields substantial performance gains. On image classification with ViT-B/32, rescaling closes 25% to 31% of the gap across all adapter counts and improves accuracy from 68.4% to 73.8% at K = 20 K{=}20 . On ViT-L/14, the improvements are even more pronounced, recovering up to 57% of the gap at K = 8 K{=}8 (improving accuracy from 83.9% to 89.1%) and 36%–42% at K = 20 K{=}20 (from 77.3% to 83.7%). On LoRAHub, rescaling recovers 25%–30% of the gap at K = 10 K{=}10 and 50% at K = 20 K{=}20 . Even across all 9 Llama-3.1 tasks combined, rescaling closes 25% to 30% of the gap.
blocks.zh: 结果。 我们在图4中显示结果。 对于每个任务和配置,我们报告从Plain SSR(α = 1\alpha = 1)到被合并模型关闭的微调上方约束的缺口百分比。 在这里,50分的分数意味着一半的差距被关闭. 跨越各个领域,不断扩大规模,产生实质性的业绩收益。 在Vit-B/32的图像分类上,将所有适配器计数的差距缩小25%至31%,并在K = 20 K = 20 K = 20时提高准确度从68.4%增至73.8%。 在Vit-L/14上,改进情况更加明显,在K = 8 K = 8 K = 8(精确度从83.9%增至89.1%)和36 = 42% 在K = 20 K = 20 K = 20(从77.3%增至83.7%)时恢复了高达57%的差距。 在LoraHub上,缩放恢复了K=10K{=}10和K=20K{=}20的25Q%–30%差距. 即使在所有9个Llama-3.1任务加在一起,缩小了25%至30%的差距。

blocks.en: Scores on LLMs are lower, especially for NLI. We also oberve that performance on generative tasks is mainly driven by IFEval, and Line Search underperforms here. We analyzed the reasons and found that (i) optimal rescaling factors for the three generative tasks are anticorrelated, so optimal performance for one task yields worst performance for the others. IFEval yields the largest gains overall, so it dominates the merge. (ii) Performance on the validation set is uncorrelated with performance on the test set, which explains why Line Search fails to select a good α \alpha . Since these problems are specific to LLM generative tasks and this is not the focus of our work, we leave further exploration to future research. Finally, we also want to clarify that rescaled SSR does not achieve state-of-the-art performance on all of these tasks, but our claim is that rescaling substantially improves SSR and other OLS-based methods.
blocks.zh: LLMs的得分较低,特别是NLI. 我们还认为,基因任务上的性能主要由IFEval驱动,而Line Search在这里表现不佳. 我们分析了原因,发现(一) 三项基因任务的最佳调整因子与抑制因子有关,因此一项任务的最佳表现对其他任务最差。 若为 Eval总体收益最大,因此主导合并. (二)验证集的性能与测试集的性能无关,这解释了为什么Line Search未能选择一个好的α\α. 由于这些问题是LLM基因任务所特有的,而这不是我们工作的重点,所以我们将进一步探索留给未来的研究。 最后,我们还希望澄清,重新调整后的安全部门改革并没有在所有这些任务上取得最先进的业绩,但我们声称,重新调整规模大大改进了安全部门改革和其他基于行动和后勤系统的方法。

blocks.en: Results. Performance gains of rescaling for RegMean and Mix-of-Show are in Tab. 3 . We include the DreamBooth task, Image Classification, and Llama-3.1 finetuning. Rescaling improves performance across almost all settings, for example raising image classification accuracy on ViT-L/14 from 81.0% to 86.7% for RegMean and DreamBooth DINO on SD3.5-M at K = 30 K{=}30 from .553 to .600, with only slight drops on Llama NLI (e.g., 86.3% to 86.0% for RegMean). blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper demonstrates and analyzes shrinkage as a problem in OLS-based model merging methods. We show that methods like SSR [ 67 ] , RegMean [ 32 ] , and Mix-of-Show [ 22 ] can achieve substantially improved performance on image generation tasks like few-shot subject-driven generation, style transfer, and concept erasue, by rescaling merged adapters. We also theoretically derive a strong heuristic for this factor. Beyond image generation, rescaling enables gains on image classification, text classification, and LLM tasks. Together, our experiments suggest that the problem as well as the proposed fix are universal to OLS-based merging. Beyond the specific performance improvements, our findings motivate re-evaluating the trade-off between local merging targets and downstream effects, which may not always be aligned. Our analysis of OLS shrinkage is a first step toward efficient merging while taking global effects into account.
blocks.zh: 本文将缩水作为基于OLS的模型合并方法中的一个问题加以展示和分析. 我们显示,SSR[67],RegMean[32],Mix-of-Show[22]等方法,可以通过调整合并适配器,大幅提高图像生成任务的性能,如少镜头主题驱动生成,风格转移,概念消除. 我们也在理论上得出了这个因素的强烈heuristic. 除了图像生成之外,缩放还能在图像分类、文本分类和LLM任务方面获得收益。 我们的实验表明,这个问题和拟议的解决方法对以业务和后勤系统为基础的合并是普遍的。 除了具体的绩效改进外,我们的调查结果还促使人们重新评价地方合并目标与下游效果之间的取舍。 我们对业务和后勤系统收缩的分析是在考虑全球影响的同时实现有效合并的第一步。

blocks.en: Limitations. While rescaling adapters fitted with OLS yields substantial improvements especially on image generation tasks, it remains a post-hoc method that mitigates shrinkage but doe not solve it during merging. Future research should develop methods to directly achieve this in one step. Our 1 / γ 1/\gamma heuristic for the scaling factor works well, but calibration sometimes fails when s ⋆ s^{\star} is far from 1 1 . Finally, like almost all merging methods, we don’t consider activation drift in the merged model across layers, which is an important next step. Finally, we find results on LLM merging weaker empirically, so better understanding this setting is also interesting but out of scope of our work.

blocks.en:
We propose to rescale merged adapters by a factor α \alpha , which can be estimated by 1 / γ 1/\gamma ( Sec. 3 ). However, PICO [ 62 ] and LiNeS [ 64 ] propose different rescaling methods for merged weight updates.
PICO proposes to rescale the Frobenius norm of the merged adapter to match the average Frobenius norm of the individual task adapters: Δ W PICO = α PICO Δ W merged with α PICO = 1 ‖ Δ ​ W PICO ‖ F ⋅ 1 K ∑ k = 1 K ∥ Δ W k ∥ F , \Delta W_{\text{PICO}}=\alpha_{\text{PICO}}\Delta W_{\mathrm{merged}}\quad\mathrm{with}\quad\alpha_{\text{PICO}}=\frac{1}{\|\Delta W_{\mathrm{PICO}}\|_{F}}\cdot\frac{1}{K}\sum_{k=1}^{K}\|\Delta W_{k}\|_{F}, (57) where Δ ​ W k \Delta W_{k} is the weight update of task k k .
LiNeS proposes to apply a different scaling factor depending on the layer, where lower layers are scaled less and upper layers are scaled more: Δ ​ W LiNeS ( ℓ ) = α LiNeS ( ℓ ) ​ W merged ( ℓ ) with α LiNeS ( ℓ ) = ξ + β ​ ℓ − 1 L − 1 , \Delta W_{\text{LiNeS}}^{(\ell)}=\alpha_{\text{LiNeS}}^{(\ell)}W_{\text{merged}}^{(\ell)}\quad\text{with}\quad\alpha_{\text{LiNeS}}^{(\ell)}=\xi+\beta\frac{\ell-1}{L-1}, (58) where ℓ \ell is the layer index (starting from 1) and L L the total number of layers. β \beta is a tunable hyperparameters, and for ξ \xi we follow the LiNeS reference implementation and estimate it as ξ = ‖ ∑ k Δ ​ W k ‖ 1 K ⋅ ‖ Δ merged ‖ 1 . \xi=\frac{\|\sum_{k}\Delta W_{k}\|_{1}}{K\cdot\|\Delta_{\text{merged}}\|_{1}}. (59) Here ∥ ⋅ ∥ 1 \|\cdot\|_{1} denotes the entrywise ℓ 1 \ell_{1} norm. β \beta is selected as the best value from β ∈ { 0.1 , … , 1.5 } \beta\in\{0.1,\ldots,1.5\} which corresponds to the TIES grid proposed in \NoHyper [ 64 ] .

Results are in Tab. 4 . Scaling the plain SSR-merged adapter with either LiNeS or PICO hurts performance throughout, and performance decreases fast as K K increases. This shows that our global scaling is fundamentally different from PICO and LiNeS scaling, and they are not directly applicable in our setting.

blocks.en: B.2 Ablation of the Calibration Data
blocks.zh: B.2 校准数据的校准

blocks.en: Setting. Wei et al. find that for plain SSR-Merging, adding more calibration data such as additional prompt templates and data from the full diffusion trajectory (i.e., all diffusion steps) does not improve performance. However, this is counterintuitive, as adapters are applied at all diffusion steps, and activations differ significantly between them. Moreover, empirically, we find the best performance of SSR + 1 / γ 1/\gamma and SSR + Line Search when including activations from the full diffusion trajectory in the calibration data.
blocks.zh: 准备 魏等编. 发现对于Plain SSR-Merging,添加更多校准数据,例如额外的即时模板和来自完整扩散轨迹的数据(即所有扩散步骤)并不能改善性能. 然而,这是反直觉的,因为适配器在所有扩散步骤中都应用过,它们之间的激活率也大不相同. 此外,从经验上看,我们在校准数据中包括从全部扩散轨迹的激活时,发现了SSR+1 / γ 1/\gamma和SSR+线搜索的最佳性能.

blocks.en: To ablate the calibration data, we systematically compare three methods (SSR, SSR + 1 / γ 1/\gamma , and SSR + Line Search) on four configurations: (One step, Trajectory) × \times (generic prompt, multiple prompts). One step vs. Trajectory compares using only the first diffusion step to collect activations for training the router R R with using activations from all diffusion steps. Generic prompt vs. multiple prompts compares using a prompt that mentions the subject (e.g., “dachshund” ), but no scene, evaluated on four different seeds for sampling diffusion noise, with four prompts that mention the subject and in addition a scene (e.g., “dachshund in a garden” ).

blocks.en: Results. In Fig. 5 , we show the DINO metric for FLUX and SD3.5-M across K = 9 , 15 , 20 , 30 K=9,15,20,30 . Therefore, our method achieves proper scaling behavior, which we expect from training-based merging methods. blocks.en: B.3 Runtime of Activation-Based Merging Methods
blocks.zh: B.3 基于激活的合并方法运行时间

blocks.en: To compare the computational cost of the activation-based merging methods, we measure the wall time and the number of floating-point operations (FLOPs) of a single merge on the DreamBooth task. Each merge combines the K adapters of one configuration ( K = 3 , 9 , 15 , 30 K=3,9,15,30 on SD3.5-Medium; K = 30 K=30 on FLUX.1-dev). All methods use the same calibration data, i.e., we evaluate a data-matched scenario: four prompt templates, each with the full 28-step sampling trajectory. Every merge starts from scratch, without cached features or stored statistics, and runs on a single GH200 GPU. We exclude the time to load the model and the adapters. For SSR, the cost includes collecting the subspace statistics of the K adapters. For SSR with line search, it also includes generating the validation images of all K K subjects and scoring them with DINO and CLIP, for each of the seven values of α \alpha from which we select the best one. On SD3.5-Medium, all methods pass over the calibration data once per adapter. On FLUX, the Gram matrices of RegMean and Mix-of-Show do not fit in GPU memory next to the model, so we compute them in chunks over replayed trajectories. We count FLOPs with PyTorch’s FLOP counter and add analytic counts for linear solves. For IterIS, we time two of its ten iterations and extrapolate to the full run due to the excessive runtime. On FLUX, IterIS is not possible to run with 30 adapters on a GH200 server, so results in Tab. 1 were obtained on B300 GPUs.
